title: A Spoonful of Outrage
premise: At the county honey competition, the grand prize jar has been replaced with treacle. Nobody is ill, but the judges are furious. Find who made the substitution and why before the public tasting begins. The competitors and staff remained on site after yesterday evening's judging rehearsal. The winning entrant, Oswald Pike, has gone to fetch his family. Dax, whose entry placed second, publicly demanded that Oswald be disqualified.

places.name: Tasting Hall
places.description: White cloths cover trestle tables. A silver bear presides over the judging seats.

places.name: Pantry
places.description: Crockery towers above a small washing sink.

places.name: Bee Garden
places.description: Visitors watch the hives from behind a low fence.

characters.name: Ada Pym
characters.persona: She treats competition administration as a diplomatic summit, tapping a silver pencil against her clipboard when procedure breaks down.
characters.speech_style: Complete sentences, elaborate courtesy, tiny corrections.
characters.fallback_line: We can discuss this without raising our voices.

characters.name: Bert Quill
characters.persona: He says he spent the evening preparing sweets for the visitors and that kitchen deliveries are routine. He polishes his brass sugar thermometer whenever questions become personal.
characters.speech_style: Food comparisons, theatrical sighs, elaborate assurances about ordinary kitchen business.
characters.fallback_line: Give me a moment to collect myself.

characters.name: Cleo Marsh
characters.persona: She is proud of her first paid job and distinguishes what she saw from what she merely thinks. She straightens her oversized steward badge before answering.
characters.speech_style: Short observations followed by careful qualifications.
characters.fallback_line: I would rather be accurate than impressive.

characters.name: Dax Venn
characters.persona: He is the show apiary steward and also a disappointed entrant. He rolls an unlit smoker between his palms and insists that his rival received preferential treatment.
characters.speech_style: Dry remarks and direct answers with no social padding.
characters.fallback_line: Tell me precisely what you want to establish.

clues.text: The tamper strip carries a violet thumbprint. The stain crosses the torn edge; beneath the seal the paper is clean.
Bert Quill signed a carbon delivery slip for one jar of black treacle at 20:10. The empty delivery carton is under his bench.
Bert Quill admits he substituted the jar to force a public inspection of Oswald Pike's bee feed. He says the BX-4 in it mattered more to him than the prize.
The retained control sample from Oswald Pike's entry tests positive for a banned additive: the laboratory sheet identifies it as BX-4 in his bee feed.
A sticky teaspoon fits the narrow opening of the replacement container; Bert Quill borrowed that exact utensil after the rehearsal and has not returned it.
The original honey is intact inside a biscuit tin with a pencilled instruction: keep for the inspector, do not serve. There is no signature.
I saw Bert Quill stain his right thumb with purple sugar colour at 20:05. At 20:00 I had sealed the genuine entry with unmarked paper.
Dax demanded the winner lose his rosette, saying he would see the judges embarrassed before morning. He had collected the display keys for closing.
The gate register records Dax supervising a continuous hive demonstration from 20:00 to 20:30. Ada countersigned each five-minute attendance box; Cleo locked the hall with the spare key at 20:20.

pointers.line: Ask Ada where I spent the evening.

solution.motive: Force inspection of an entrant who was mistreating bees with a banned additive.
solution.method: Replace the sealed honey entry with delivered treacle and keep the original for inspection.
true_timeline: 19:50 Bert learns that Oswald Pike has been feeding BX-4 to his bees.
20:00 Cleo seals the genuine entry with a clean strip.
20:10 Bert receives treacle and borrows the utensil.
20:15 Bert exchanges the contents, marks the strip and saves the original honey.
